[[Category:Activation function]]
Gaussian error linear unit is an [[activation function]] liked for its smoothness.

== Definition ==

$$
\operatorname{GELU}(z)=z\,\Phi(z)
$$

where 

$$
\Phi(z)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\int_{-\infty}^{z} e^{-t^2/2}\,dt
$$

is the [[normal distribution|standard normal cumulative distribution function]].

== Application ==

GELU is commonly used in [[Transformer]] [[feed-Forward Network (FFN) Sub-Layer (Transformer)|feed-forward sub-layers]].
